name: District Disaster Management Emergency Helpline (1077)
department: Revenue and Disaster Management / District Collectorates, MP
beneficiary: District-level residents during localized flash floods and weather emergencies
benefits: Direct communication with local district collectorate emergency cells.
eligibility: Anyone facing localized disaster situations in any MP district
application_process: Dial 1077 within the district to route to the local collectorate control room.
